jobs.prompt: Experiment E2 measurement (swarm-metrics.md → Experiments → E2, 'Measurement first'). Add a `ship` block to coordination/tools/session_metrics.py: a new flag `--ship-logs <glob or files>` (also read automatically when a root's worktrees/*-ship*.log files are given) that parses swarm ship log files (each line or file is one JSON object with fields branch, status ∈ refused|held|ci-failed|merged|..., reason, code, timing) and reports per branch: attempts (number of ship records), refusals by code, and minutes from the first attempt to the first record whose status is held or merged or that carries a pushed sha (use file mtimes when the record has no timestamp; say so in the output). Print it inside the existing JSON/text output as `ship: {branches:[{branch, attempts, refusedCodes:{code:n}, minutesToFirstPush}]}` and add `--ship-only`. Keep every existing flag and output unchanged. Tests in coordination/tools/test_session_metrics_ship.py (pytest, fake log files with fake branch names, no real names): 3 refusals then held → attempts 4, minutes computed from given mtimes; a merged-first branch → attempts 1, 0 minutes; a missing/garbled line is skipped with a count. Run `python3 -m pytest coordination/tools -q` and make it green. Then run the tool on the six real worktrees/swarm-w-ship*.log files (context) with --ship-only and write the result to .swarm-manifests/e2-metrics-result.json (this is the E2 baseline row: batch W attempts and minutes to first push). Do not edit swarm-metrics.md. Return JSON only, max 7 lines: {"status":"done|blocked","filesChanged":["..."],"findings":["..."],"reproTest":"coordination/tools/test_session_metrics_ship.py::<name>","batchW":{"attempts":N,"minutesToFirstPush":N},"pytest":"N passed","open":[]}
